entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Denis Eugene Hurley, OMI OMSG was a South African Catholic prelate who served as Vicar Apostolic of Natal from 1946 to 1951 and as Archbishop of Durban from 1951 to 1992. He was a member of the Oblates of Mary Immaculate.
